# Tailrocks: Contribute Respond

`tailrocks-contribute-respond` — part of [tailrocks-skills](../../README.md) · [documentation](https://skills.tailrocks.com/docs/skills/tailrocks-contribute-respond)

Handle one submitted contribution's current review round through approved local fixes and separately approved remote actions. Never auto-posts, auto-pushes, escalates, or carries approval between actions.

## Invocation

This skill never activates on its own. Name it in your request:

> Use `tailrocks-contribute-respond` …

Arguments: `<submitted contribution handoff>`
